case_number: Civil Appeal No. 6810 of 2022 (@ SLP (C) No. 11216 of 2022)
summary: Condonation of delay in filing Section 34 arbitration petition; statutory condonable period of 30 days under proviso to Section 34(3) of Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996; whether Section 10 of General Clauses Act, 1897 applies to statutory grace period when last day falls on court holiday; review of limitations law vacuum; distinction between 'prescribed period' under Limitation Act and broader application of Section 10; High Court's reliance on Assam Urban case rejected; appeal allowed on principle of elementary justice and lex non cogit ad impossibilia.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; condonation of delay granted; arbitration petition restored to trial court for hearing on merits.
